label: Tier 1: configuration
subgoals: Identify requests that change only a value, a table or a component choice
Apply them through configuration without a rebuild
Record each change so it can be reversed

label: Tier 2: a plug-in at the seam
section: Tier 2: a plug-in at the seam
subgoals: Recognize a rule that no parameter can express
Check that the seam's context already carries the fields the rule needs
Implement the rule as a provider and validate it with differential tests

label: Tier 3: a core edit
subgoals: Identify changes to propagation, conventions or the delay-model API
Route them through a reviewed diff with full regression
Extend the seam once so similar requests become plug-ins
